issue.description:
ADR-005 records, as a known drawback, that doctor's ready_frontier check reads assignment state directly, making its notion of 'excluded from the frontier' a second implementation of the exclusion rule that claim selection owns — the two can drift and report different frontiers. Consolidate both behind one shared eligibility explanation (unfinished blockers, manual blocking, assignment), keep the doctor check advisory-only (never clearing an assignee, not even under --repair), and add tests asserting the check's exclusion notion is exactly the rule that governs claim selection.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Share one ready-frontier eligibility explanation between claim selection and doctor

issue.description:
ADR-005 records as an open drawback that there is 'currently no way to mark an assignment as intentionally held', so legitimately parked open+assigned issues fire the ready_frontier starvation warning on every run and train operators to ignore the check. Work: design an explicit hold marker (stored field, label, or documented convention); exempt held issues from the warning while keeping the check advisory-only — doctor never clears an assignee, not even under --repair; document the marker in the field guide; add doctor-output tests for held and unheld assignments; while in the area, derive the check's frontier-exclusion from R001's shared eligibility rule instead of the second implementation ADR-005 calls out.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Let an assignment be marked intentionally held so doctor's ready_frontier warning can exempt it
